note: Search words only: no article text, no quote, no definition. ground_definitions.py sends each search as (SEARCH) AND search_filter AND licence_filter to Europe PMC, and a definition_search first with definition_filter added, and accepts a quote only when it holds one of the target's terms. A verified quote proves the words exist in an open-access article, not that the definition is right.
licence_filter: (LICENSE:"cc by" OR LICENSE:"cc0" OR LICENSE:"cc by-sa" OR LICENSE:"cc by-nc" OR LICENSE:"cc by-nc-sa" OR LICENSE:"cc by-nd" OR LICENSE:"cc by-nc-nd")
definition_filter: (PUB_TYPE:"review" OR PUB_TYPE:"guideline" OR PUB_TYPE:"practice guideline" OR PUB_TYPE:"consensus development conference")
to_verify: search_filter: OPEN_ACCESS:y and HAS_FT:y are Europe PMC search fields recalled from its search syntax reference, not read from it in this build; to verify on the first real run

licence_filter: the LICENSE field and these value spellings are recalled, not read; to verify on the first real run. If the first target returns hitCount 0 on every search, rerun with --no-licence-filter (the licence of every hit is still checked by the tool)
AFF: (affiliation) and LANG: (language) in the Spanish searches are recalled field names; to verify on the first real run

definition_filter: PUB_TYPE and these publication-type values are recalled, not read; to verify on the first real run. When the filtered definition search answers 0 hits the tool runs it once more without the filter and the report says so; --no-definition-filter leaves the filter out
definition_search: whether Europe PMC matches the quoted cue phrases ('is defined as', 'refers to', 'is a measure of') in the full text or only in title and abstract; to verify on the first real run
